cover_letter:
Dear Square Melon Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Junior Search Engine Advertising Executive role, as advertised on Digimedia. As a Junior Digital Marketer with hands-on experience in Google Ads for performance tracking, Google Analytics, and comprehensive SEO strategies, I am eager to apply my skills and grow within your Google Business Generator team.

My current role at Episto involves significant responsibility for managing on-page SEO, conducting keyword research, and maintaining client websites. This has provided me with a robust understanding of search visibility, content optimization, and the critical role of data in driving online success. Crucially, I regularly track site performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to inform strategic decisions. While my primary focus has been SEO, this direct engagement with Google Ads for monitoring and analysis makes me uniquely prepared to transition into setting up and optimizing SEA campaigns. My ability to evaluate websites for search engine popularity and build targeted content aligns seamlessly with the requirements for building effective ad copy and identifying relevant search terms.

Beyond professional experience, my independent project, mirook.com, demonstrates my proactive approach and technical aptitude. I designed and built the site, implemented structured data for enhanced visibility, and performed iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably improving its search-health score. This project underscores my analytical thinking, precision, and a genuine passion for the internet and digital marketing—qualities I believe are essential for an SEA executive. I am a quick and eager learner, ready to obtain the Google AdWords Professional certificate and continuously share new insights.

I am particularly drawn to Square Melon’s expanding new department, which promises significant growth opportunities. I am confident that my foundational digital marketing expertise, coupled with my analytical mindset and commitment to quality, would make me a valuable addition.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to Square Melon’s success.
